description: Use when a contract, a venue or a person needs the signed Tickerz print for an index: the report (ticker, period, value as a scaled integer with decimals, status provisional, final or corrected, rule version and hash, the provider reads with their snapshot hashes, settleable), its hash, the publisher's Ed25519 signature, the independent recount's co-signatures, and the Solana feed account that holds it. Optional period (YYYY-MM-DD; a month as YYYY-MM-01). How to verify: https://tickerz.com/.well-known/tickerz-signer.json. Same data as GET /api/indices/{ticker}/report.

period.description: The period, YYYY-MM-DD; newest when left out

ticker.description: Index ticker, with or without the dollar sign

name: get_report
title: Signed report
